meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Myanmar merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: Central Statistical Organization (CSO) institutional core
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Organization
reports.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics. Publishes the Statistical Yearbook and participates in the IMF enhanced General Data Dissemination System (e-GDDS).
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the Myanmar statistical system. Data continuity and coverage are constrained relative to many peers.

reports.title: Population census and estimates
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Organization / related
reports.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. Population is approximately 55 million; the age structure remains relatively young.
reports._notes: Core demographic node. Population ~55 million.

reports.title: National Accounts of Myanmar (GDP)
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Organization / related
reports.description: Official national accounts (GDP). Central macro-output series for an economy heavily shaped by agriculture, extractives, informal activity and political-institutional constraints.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. Interpretation requires care given data gaps and informal activity.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Organization
reports.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has been elevated and volatile in recent years under exchange-rate pressures and supply disruptions.
reports._notes: Core high-frequency price node under elevated-inflation conditions.

reports.title: Central Bank of Myanmar institutional and reporting core
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Myanmar
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, BOP and related series where available.
reports._notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart to CSO.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Myanmar / related
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Current-account dynamics, limited FDI, and large errors and omissions reflecting informal and unrecorded cross-border activity are recurring features.
reports._notes: External-accounts node under constrained data and institutional conditions.

reports.title: Myanmar foundational statistical-system meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from CSO and CBM sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the CSO institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBM institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Myanmar research.
reports._notes: Opening integrating node for Myanmar research. Data quality and coverage constraints should be carried forward in subsequent batches.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

reports.title: Agriculture production statistics
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Organization / related
reports.description: Official and compiled statistics on crop and livestock production. Agriculture remains a large share of employment and rural livelihoods; rice is the dominant staple and a material export crop.
reports._notes: Core primary-sector production node. Data coverage is incomplete relative to pre-2021 benchmarks.

reports.title: Rice production and area statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from CSO and remote-sensing / agricultural monitoring sources
reports.description: Statistics and estimates on rice cultivation area and production. Ayeyarwady and other delta/lowland regions are central; production levels interact with climate, conflict and input constraints.
reports._notes: Foundational food-security crop node under constrained conditions.

reports.title: Natural gas production and export statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from trade and energy sources
reports.description: Statistics on natural gas production and exports. Petroleum gas is among Myanmar’s largest export commodities by value; primary destinations include Thailand and China.
reports._notes: High-centrality extractive and export node.

reports.title: Myanmar–China merchandise trade statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from Chinese customs and related sources
reports.description: Bilateral trade with China. China is a dominant trade partner; Myanmar exports include ores, mineral fuels, rubber, copper and agricultural products; imports include vehicles, machinery, electrical equipment and fabrics. Border and informal flows are material.
reports._notes: Primary bilateral trade corridor under constrained official data.

reports.title: Myanmar agriculture–extractives–China densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from agricultural, energy and trade sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding agriculture and rice statistics, natural gas production/exports, and Myanmar–China trade into a coherent primary-sector, extractives and external layer under constrained data conditions.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 2 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
National accounts, CPI, BOP and CBM series from Batch 1

reports.title: Poverty and living standards statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from World Bank-aligned and national monitoring sources
reports.description: Poverty rates and living-standards indicators. Poverty had declined substantially before 2021; subsequent conflict, economic contraction and displacement have reversed gains and elevated vulnerability, especially in conflict-affected areas.
reports._notes: Core welfare measurement node under elevated stress conditions.

reports.title: Exchange-rate regime and parallel-market statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Myanmar / parallel-market trackers
reports.description: Official and parallel-market exchange rates for the kyat. Multiple rates and a persistent parallel-market premium are structural features under currency controls, limited FX availability and elevated inflation.
reports._notes: Critical price and external-constraint node. Parallel-market premium is a key signal.

reports.title: Jade and gemstone production / export framing
reports.publisher: Derived from trade and sector sources
reports.description: Framing and available statistics on jade and gemstone production and exports. Jade has historically been a major foreign-exchange and informal-economy activity, with strong China-linked demand and limited transparency.
reports._notes: High-centrality informal and extractive densification. Data quality is particularly limited.

reports.title: Myanmar poverty–exchange–jade densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from welfare, CBM and extractives sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding poverty and living-standards statistics, exchange-rate/parallel-market statistics, and jade/gemstone framing into a coherent welfare–monetary–extractive layer under constrained conditions.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 3 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
CPI, BOP, gas and China trade series from earlier batches

reports.title: Labour force and employment statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from ILO modelled estimates and national sources
reports.description: Labour-force participation, employment-to-population ratio and unemployment rates. Participation is in the low-60s percent range; unemployment is moderate by modelled estimates, but informal employment and underemployment are widespread and conflict has disrupted livelihoods.
reports._notes: Primary labour-market node under constrained survey conditions.

reports.title: Fiscal balance and budget deficit statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from World Bank-aligned and national fiscal monitoring
reports.description: Fiscal balance and deficit indicators. The deficit has widened in recent fiscal years (mid-single-digit percent of GDP range) under reconstruction, security and recurrent spending pressures, with weak tax collection and reliance on domestic financing including central-bank channels.
reports._notes: Core fiscal-flow node under constrained revenue and elevated spending pressures.

reports.title: Border trade statistics and framing
reports.publisher: Derived from Ministry of Commerce and monitoring sources
reports.description: Statistics and analytical framing of official and informal border trade, especially with China and Thailand. Border trade volumes have fluctuated sharply with conflict, checkpoint control and infrastructure disruption; informal and non-state-controlled flows remain material.
reports._notes: High-centrality trade densification under fragmented territorial control.

reports.title: Myanmar labour–fiscal–border densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from labour, fiscal and trade sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding labour force statistics, fiscal balance/deficit indicators, and border trade framing into a coherent labour–fiscal–trade layer under constrained conditions.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 4 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Poverty, CPI, China trade and BOP series from earlier batches

reports.title: Internal displacement and humanitarian needs statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from OCHA / UN Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan and monitoring sources
reports.description: Statistics on internal displacement and humanitarian needs. Internally displaced persons are in the multi-million range (approximately 3.7 million cited in recent monitoring); the 2026 Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan projects over 16 million people requiring assistance. Conflict, insecurity and disaster overlays drive large-scale vulnerability.
reports._notes: High-centrality humanitarian and social-stress node. Distinctive under current conditions.

reports.title: Rare earths and critical minerals production framing
reports.publisher: Derived from USGS and trade sources
reports.description: Framing of rare earths, tin, antimony and related critical-mineral production. Myanmar ranks among the world’s larger producers of rare earths, tin and antimony; much production is artisanal or outside full government control, with China the primary destination.
reports._notes: Critical-minerals densification complementing gas and jade.

reports.title: Education and learning outcomes framing
reports.publisher: Derived from World Bank, UNICEF and national monitoring sources
reports.description: Framing of education access and learning outcomes. Foundational literacy and numeracy were already weak pre-crisis (very high learning poverty); subsequent disruption has further eroded proficiency and participation.
reports._notes: Human-capital densification under severe stress.

reports.title: Myanmar displacement–minerals–education densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from humanitarian, mineral and education sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding internal displacement and humanitarian needs, rare earths/critical minerals framing, and education/learning outcomes into a coherent humanitarian–extractive–human-capital residual layer under constrained conditions.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 5 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Poverty, labour, China trade and extractives series from earlier batches

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

_gaps.note: What is genuinely missing and cannot be fixed mechanically — this is the research queue, not a defect list.
